name: baseline

sourceRender.optics: exact sphere/cylinder intersections, vector Snell refraction, Fresnel, finite real stop, finite M1
sourceRender.scene: analytic cabinet and book boxes, synthetic monochrome printed textures, diffuse direct + ambient lighting
sourceRender.imageCorrection: horizontal digital mirror flip only; no image squeeze, perspective rectification, denoise or sharpen

correction: inverse calibration of exact chief rays onto Z=60mm reference plane; intensity from same rendered observation only; transparent regions have a blocked chief or unconverged inverse; no clean texture or book silhouette input
limitations: single wavelength geometric optics, not a photograph
no full diffraction/broadband colour/sensor noise/manufacturing tolerance
reached cells are not OCR accuracy
chief-ray density does not include finite-pupil blur
inverse camera root failure is reported separately from forward-render reach
